messages:
rachel: CI red on main — golden diff for render_snapshots::prompt_serialization. Not sure if legit, looks like whitespace vs serialization escaping. @kevin @sam can someone take a quick look? cc: @ci-bot
ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline #213 failed: //eng-ml/tests:golden_tests (diff detected). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/213/jobs/failed -- failing test list attached.
kevin: on it, grabbing raw output + the diff. can you paste the failing test name and a snippet of the diff here?
sam: I pulled the job and reran locally: `bazel test //eng-ml/tests:golden_tests --test_output=all` — reproduced. Failing lines show changed escaping and an extra trailing newline removed in serialized prompt. Example diff:
```
- prompt: "Hello \u2028 world\n"
+ prompt: "Hello \u2028 world"
```
kevin: that smells like the serializer started trimming final newlines or toggling `escape_non_ascii`. any recent PRs touching prompt serialization?
sam: PR #4156 touched json serialization for prompts (unicode handling). quick bisect plan: 1) git bisect start HEAD v2025-10-01 2) run `./tools/run-golden --filter prompt_serialization` at each step. I can start.
kevin: sounds good. if bisect points to that PR we need to decide: preserve previous serialization for golds or update golds. For immediate unblock, a rerun after a fix is best.
rachel: :thumbsup: if you need to rebaseline the golds, use `./tools/goldctl upload --suite prompt_serialization --local ./tmp/golds` and ping me for review. Also please include a short changelog note so QA knows why golds changed.
sam: bisect finished — culprit commit 9a7f2c5 introduced `escape_non_ascii = true` and removed newline preservation. Filing a PR to either make that opt-in or add a compatibility flag. Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng/pull/4229
kevin: nice catch. once the PR lands, @ci-bot will rerun pipeline #213 automatically (or you can `@ci-bot rerun pipeline #213 --tests golden_tests`). rachel can you prioritize a quick review of the gold upload if we opt to rebaseline?
rachel: I can review the rebaseline. also can we add a small unit that asserts serialized prompt roundtrip preserves trailing newline for the prompt_serialization suite? would have caught this.
sam: will add test in the PR. ETA ~45m to get PR up with test and option to keep old behavior behind a flag.
kevin: thanks. marking this thread as tracking — ping here when PR merges and CI green so we can close the incident. :white_check_mark:
